settings.heading: Healing Happens In Relationship.
settings.subheading: The body holds what the mind cannot yet process. At Center for Balanced Living, we integrate polyvagal-informed care, somatic awareness, and evidence-based trauma treatment for individuals, families, and children navigating complex trauma, anxiety, and developmental wounds.

settings.statement: What we know from polyvagal theory: safety is not a thought. It is a physiological state. Our clinical work is built on that premise.

settings.eyebrow: Where would you like to begin
settings.heading: Three Pathways to Support

settings.title: Center for Balanced Living
settings.description: Therapy, psychological evaluation, and group treatment for individuals and families. Trauma-based care grounded in polyvagal theory, IFS, and somatic experiencing.

settings.title: CFBL Institute
settings.description: Continuing education for licensed clinicians. Live workshops and on-demand courses in trauma assessment, nervous system theory, and applied clinical reasoning.

settings.title: MUSA
settings.description: Books and essays on psychology, memory, and being human. Longer-form writing by Dr. Angela Serravalle for readers interested in the science and phenomenology of trauma.

settings.heading: Individual Therapy
settings.description: One-on-one therapy for adults and adolescents navigating complex trauma, anxiety, grief, and identity disruption. We draw on EMDR, IFS, somatic experiencing, and attachment-based approaches. Treatment is tailored to your window of tolerance.

settings.heading: Psychological Evaluations
settings.description: Comprehensive evaluations for children, adolescents, and adults. We assess for autism, ADHD, learning differences, and complex trauma presentations. Reports are written for clinical utility, not just diagnosis.

settings.heading: Wellness Groups
settings.description: Community-grounded groups focused on grief, somatic resourcing, and nervous system regulation. Structured and time-limited, informed by current research in polyvagal theory and group trauma treatment.

settings.heading: One practice. Three doors.
settings.subheading: Center for Balanced Living, CFBL Institute, and MUSA each serve a distinct audience with a distinct clinical voice. Three doors. One integrated practice.

settings.name: Dr. Angela (Niki) Serravalle
settings.bio_short: A trauma-based psychologist, educator, and writer. Founder of Center for Balanced Living, CFBL Institute, and MUSA.

settings.title: Trauma-Based Assessment: Integrating the ACEs Framework
settings.description: A six-hour workshop integrating psychometric assessment with nervous system theory. We examine how trauma presentations affect test performance, scoring validity, and diagnostic clarity. For licensed clinicians in trauma, forensic, and educational settings.

settings.heading: New writing on psychology, memory, and being human.

settings.title: On Memory and the Body: What Trauma Teaches Us About Time
settings.lede: The body keeps a record that the mind is still learning to read. This essay explores what clinical work reveals about traumatic memory, the limits of narrative, and why trauma treatment must begin below the neck.

settings.heading: Ready to take the first step?
settings.subheading: We are accepting new clients. A free 15-minute consultation helps us understand what you are looking for and whether we are the right fit.
